list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model AS __text, model AS __value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE model <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'All' AS __text, '$__all' AS __value ORDER BY 1
list.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT model AS __text, model AS __value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE model <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'All' AS __text, '$__all' AS __value ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(spend)::float AS "Spend ($)" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND model = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Requests" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND model = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
SELECT AVG(spend)::float AS "$ / request" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND model = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])

SELECT date_trunc('day', "startTime") AS time, model AS metric, SUM(spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND model = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', "startTime") AS time, 'prompt' AS metric, SUM(prompt_tokens)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND model = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', "startTime"), 'completion', SUM(completion_tokens)::float FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND model = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT model AS metric, SUM(spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND model = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COALESCE(keys.key_alias, 'unknown') AS metric, SUM(logs.spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" logs LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" keys ON keys.token = logs.api_key WHERE $__timeFilter(logs."startTime") AND logs.model = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT "request_id", model, spend, total_tokens, "startTime" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND model = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 20
